articles.title: Nvidia Crisis Fuels US and China Chip Showdown
articles.description: Get a jump start on the US trading day on "Bloomberg Open Interest."Microsoft races to recover from a global outage disrupting users worldwide. Plus, Nvidia’s crisis turns into a US, China chip showdown ahead of a Trump-Xi meeting. Plus, Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO demand, what lingering Iran risks could mean for markets and Boston Fed President Susan Collins join us for an exclusive interview on why more rate tightening is needed. (Source: Bloomberg)
